note: OlliteRT /v1/embeddings `parallel` (computeEmbeddingBatch) measurement. P8P GPU, ~800-word (~1000-tok) docs, 768-dim. build 1228 / 876afa49, 2026-11-12.
VERDICT: GPU-SERIALIZED: parallel is NEUTRAL for 1024-tok docs (~N x solo, tiny pipelining overlap, no 2x/4x win). Short-doc bursts get modest overlap.
WHY: llama.cpp --parallel batches tokens from all slots into ONE forward pass (amortizes weight loads). LiteRT computeEmbeddingBatch runs N SEPARATE forward passes that time-slice the one Mali-G715; token-batching is not in LiteRT's public API. 1024-tok docs are GPU-compute-bound on the P8P.
